caption: The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background and features a single object centrally positioned. The object appears to be made of metal and is rendered in shades of brown and gray with some subtle shading to suggest its three-dimensional form. It consists of a looped handle to the left, which curves back on itself in an oval shape, and extends rightward into a long, tapering point. Near the center of the object, there is a small cylindrical container or holder attached to the main horizontal element. Near the lower right of the drawing, the artist’s signature, “DANA BARTLETT,” is written in small, uppercase letters. There are no other objects or details in the composition, and the background remains clear and free of ornamentation.
title: Candle Holder
